name: King Abdulaziz International Airport

runway.v: three runways; the longest, 16C/34C and 16L/34R, are 4,000 m long and 60 m wide (16R/34L is 3,800 m)

slots.v: no carrier may operate without slots from the slot coordinator ACL and prior landing permission from GACA; the document defines general aviation but does not say directly whether GA flights need slots
slots.quote: No Carrier shall operate to or from KAIA without first obtaining Slots from ACL and prior landing permission from GACA.

permits.v: ad hoc flights need prior GACA landing permission and traffic rights; ad hoc and charter helicopter flights are not permitted at JED
permits.quote: These flights are subject to prior GACA landing permission and traffic rights.

noise.quote: Aircraft defined in ICAO Annex 16 as "Noise Chapter 2" are prohibited from operating at KAIA.
